{
  "problem_id": "checkArray_to_elm",
  "functions": [],
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "start",
      "label": "Start",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "next": 2
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Input user data",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['nums']=ctx['arg0']; ctx['k']=ctx['arg1']; ctx['n']=len(ctx['nums']); ctx['diff']=[0]*(ctx['n']+1); ctx['cur']=0; ctx['i']=0; ctx['result']=True; ctx['final']=None",
      "next": 3
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "type": "decision",
      "label": "Valid data?",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "logic": "ctx['n'] > 0 and 1 <= ctx['k'] <= ctx['n']",
      "true_next": 4,
      "false_next": 5
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Process data",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "while ctx['i'] < ctx['n']:\\n        if ctx['i'] >= ctx['k']:\\n            ctx['cur'] -= ctx['diff'][ctx['i'] - ctx['k']]\\n        if ctx['nums'][ctx['i']] - ctx['cur'] < 0:\\n            ctx['final'] = False\\n            break\\n        inc = ctx['nums'][ctx['i']] - ctx['cur']\\n        if ctx['i'] + ctx['k'] <= ctx['n']:\\n            ctx['diff'][ctx['i']] = inc\\n            ctx['cur'] += inc\\n            ctx['i'] += 1\\n        else:\\n            if inc != 0:\\n                ctx['final'] = False\\n            else:\\n                ctx['i'] += 1\\n            break\\nelse:\\n        ctx['final'] = True",
      "next": 5
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Output result",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['final'] = ctx['final']",
      "next": 6
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "type": "end",
      "label": "End",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "output": "ctx['final']"
    }
  ]
}

    {
      "id": 2,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Input data",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['nums'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['target'] = ctx['arg1']",
      "next": 3
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Initialize n and S",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums']); ctx['S'] = sum(ctx['nums'])",
      "next": 4
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Compute k and rem",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['k'] = ctx['target'] // ctx['S']; ctx['rem'] = ctx['target'] % ctx['S']",
      "next": 5
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "type": "decision",
      "label": "rem == 0?",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "logic": "ctx['rem'] == 0",
      "true_next": 9,
      "false_next": 6
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Initialize rem-window",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['windowRem'] = 0; ctx['startRem'] = 0; ctx['minLenRem'] = 10**9",
      "next": 7
    },
    {
      "id": 7,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Scan 2n elements to find minLenRem",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "for end in range(0, 2 * ctx['n']):\n  idx = end % ctx['n']\n  ctx['windowRem'] += ctx['nums'][idx]\n  while ctx['windowRem'] > ctx['rem']:\n    ctx['windowRem'] -= ctx['nums'][ctx['startRem'] % ctx['n']]\n    ctx['startRem'] += 1\n  if ctx['windowRem'] == ctx['rem']:\n    curr_len = end - ctx['startRem'] + 1\n    if curr_len < ctx['minLenRem']:\n      ctx['minLenRem'] = curr_len",
      "next": 8
    },
    {
      "id": 8,
      "type": "decision",
      "label": "minLenRem < INF?",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "logic": "ctx['minLenRem'] < 10**9",
      "true_next": 11,
      "false_next": 13
    },
    {
      "id": 9,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "ctx['result'] = ctx['k'] * ctx['n']",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['result'] = ctx['k'] * ctx['n']",
      "next": 10
    },
    {
      "id": 10,
      "type": "end",
      "label": "End",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "output": "ctx['result']"
    },
    {
      "id": 11,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "ctx['result'] = ctx['k'] * ctx['n'] + ctx['minLenRem']",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['result'] = ctx['k'] * ctx['n'] + ctx['minLenRem']",
      "next": 12
    },
    {
      "id": 12,
      "type": "end",
      "label": "End",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "output": "ctx['result']"
    },
    {
      "id": 13,
      "type": "end",
      "label": "End",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "output": "-1"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "problem_id": "maxFrequencyScore_ELM",
  "functions": [],
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "start",
      "label": "Start",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "next": 2
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Input: nums (List[int]), k (integer)",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['nums']=ctx['arg0']; ctx['k']=ctx['arg1']",
      "next": 3
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Sort nums",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['nums'].sort()",
      "next": 4
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Initialize sum_vals = [0]+list(accumulate(nums))",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['sum_vals']=[0]; for v in ctx['nums']: ctx['sum_vals'].append(ctx['sum_vals'][-1] + v)",
      "next": 5
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Initialize left = 0",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['left']=0; ctx['right']=1",
      "next": 6
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "type": "decision",
      "label": "Loop: For right from 1 to len(sum_vals) - 1",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "logic": "ctx['right'] <= len(ctx['sum_vals']) - 1",
      "true_next": 7,
      "false_next": 12
    },
    {
      "id": 7,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Calculate mid = (right + left) // 2",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['mid'] = (ctx['right'] + ctx['left']) // 2",
      "next": 8
    },
    {
      "id": 8,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Calculate val = (sum_vals[right] - sum_vals[mid]) - (right - mid) * nums[mid]",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['val'] = (ctx['sum_vals'][ctx['right']] - ctx['sum_vals'][ctx['mid']]) - (ctx['right'] - ctx['mid']) * ctx['nums'][ctx['mid']]",
      "next": 9
    },
    {
      "id": 9,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Update val += (mid - left) * nums[mid] - (sum_vals[mid] - sum_vals[left])",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['val'] += (ctx['mid'] - ctx['left']) * ctx['nums'][ctx['mid']] - (ctx['sum_vals'][ctx['mid']] - ctx['sum_vals'][ctx['left']])",
      "next": 10
    },
    {
      "id": 10,
      "type": "decision",
      "label": "Is val > k?",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "logic": "ctx['val'] > ctx['k']",
      "true_next": 11,
      "false_next": 13
    },
    {
      "id": 11,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Update left += 1",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "ctx['left'] += 1",
      "next": 13
    },
    {
      "id": 12,
      "type": "return",
      "label": "Return right - left",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "value": "ctx['right'] - ctx['left']"
    },
    {
      "id": 13,
      "type": "process",
      "label": "Continue loop",
      "bbox": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 0, "height": 0},
      "action": "",
      "next": 6
    }
  ]
}
